Identical to the published pseudocount-1e5 entry except for one added correction, so the pair is a clean A/B on it. dCas9-KRAB parked at a target promoter also silences whatever else is transcribed from that promoter, so a gene whose TSS sits within about a kilobase of the target's is knocked down alongside it; these pairs are almost always divergent. Measured on the 2025 H1 ground truth with GENCODE v47 TSS coordinates: 53 of 300 targets have such a neighbour, 67 percent of those neighbours fall below minus 0.2 log units against 1 percent of background genes, and the strongest reach minus 1.2 to minus 2.4 on well expressed genes. The implied remaining fraction f runs 0.17 within 500 bp and 0.53 from 500 to 1000 bp on Arc's platform, against 0.55 to 0.71 in the public reference lines, whose on-target knockdown is itself two to three times weaker; a reference averaged transfer therefore under predicts these genes badly. Each neighbour within 5 kb is floored at log1p(f times expm1(c)) minus c with f ramping from 0.15 to 1.0 in log distance, so the correction is expression aware and a gene the context does not transcribe cannot move. 75 pairs on this panel, 62 to 63 values changed per context. H1 six member pre-flight: overall 0.2455 to 0.2474, discrimination raw 0.8731 to 0.8777, with the four differential expression members unchanged to four decimals because those genes were already being called.
